question.worked_solution:
The period of $y=\operatorname{csc}⁡x$ is $2\pi .$ Therefore, for integer $n$ we have

$$
\operatorname{csc}⁡x=\operatorname{csc}⁡(x+2n\pi ).
$$

Substituting $n=-3$ into the right-hand-side of the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{csc}⁡x=\operatorname{csc}⁡(x+2\cdot (-3)\cdot \pi )=\operatorname{csc}⁡(x-6\pi ).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, if $\operatorname{csc}⁡x=-3,$ then $\operatorname{csc}⁡(x-6\pi )=-3.$

Finally, then

$$
\begin{aligned}3\operatorname{csc}⁡(x-6\pi )+4 & =3(-3)+4 \\  & =-9+4 \\  & =-5.\end{aligned}
$$
